mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, enabled, system, version FROM iam_role ORDER BY id
SELECT id, code, name, enabled, system, version FROM iam_role WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT g.permission_code, g.scope, u.unit_id FROM iam_role_grant g LEFT JOIN iam_role_grant_unit u ON u.role_id = g.role_id AND u.permission_code = g.permission_code WHERE g.role_id = #{id} ORDER BY g.permission_code, u.unit_id
